digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and command discovery
propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes lack committed help artifacts and fail discovery under `rebar help <command>` and overview help
Identity child parsers disable help actions causing `rebar identity create --help` to reach top-level usage and exit with error
CLI help predicate must be standardized to `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across all four census sites without adding route metadata
Parser-owned summaries for `reconcile.build`, `enrich.build`, `identity.build`, and `certs.build_trusted_env` must populate overview help
Usage unwrapping and metavar normalization utilities must be consolidated and applied consistently while preserving explicit multiline `trusted-env` usage
Committed help artifacts must be generated for all newly discovered intercept routes and remain invariant across Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13
